title: Heavy-tier harness 3/5: ports with one owner (OS-assigned, empty fixed-port registry)
description:
Piece 3 of LIN-4219's approved plan: ports get one owner, and the system tier uses OS-assigned ports. **Blocked by piece 2 (exit codes and pre-flight).** Pieces 2 and 3 share `startHarbour` and `systemSuite`, and the plan suggested one session for both. They are split here so each lands alone. Running them back to back in one session is fine.

## Slice of the approved plan (pruned at close-out)

Implemented as approved: `test/system/harness/ports.js` (OS-assigned allocator + empty frozen `FIXED_PORTS` registry), `startHarbour` allocates per boot with readiness tied to the child's own listen line and a bounded (3 attempts) EADDRINUSE retry, port defaults removed, every literal port in `test/system/*.test.js` converted (`wake-invariants` converted, not registered), census rule (c) added. PR: [https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/320](<https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/320>) (merged as `3330526`). Deviations: `systemSuite` refuses a `port` option (witness added at close-out); the registry-to-preflight wiring is deliberately not built (recorded on LIN-4219). The full plan text is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail.

## Testing strategy (witnesses)

* The two system files that share 4163 today (`pending-child-relay.test.js:23`, `auto-pause.test.js:68`) pass when run together.
* Census rule (c) passes in `npm test`, and it fails when a literal port is put back.
* A readiness witness: when the port is already held by another server, the started Harbour's boot is not reported ready, and the retry fires.
* The full `npm run test:system` run is green.

## Acceptance

* No literal ports in `test/system/*.test.js`. No port defaults in the harness. The registry is empty, or each entry has a recorded reason.
* The port prerequisite is removed, not checked: `preflight`'s `ports` need applies only to registry files.

---

**Parent:** LIN-4219 — *simple-dispatcher: the heavy test tier stands on one harness*. The parent's description holds the full scope, the "Done when" and "At merge" lists, the layout table and the **Implementation Plan**. Its comment trail holds the approving `### Plan Review Verdict` (comment `4ea51c1c-fa0a-44b9-9a63-c614f8fd7f56`). Read both before starting.

**Starting point:** the parent's approved plan is where this piece starts. Read it in full in LIN-4219's description, under "Implementation Plan". Follow it. Where the code shows it is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4219.

Session fit: fits one session
Plan-review due: no — covered by LIN-4219's approving plan-review (comment 4ea51c1c-fa0a-44b9-9a63-c614f8fd7f56, rev 1; the verdict names no revision number, and this is the only plan revision and the only verdict on the trail)
Grounding commit: simple-dispatcher `main` @ `502901c` (plan and review both grounded here; re-checked at breakdown on 2026-11-04, and nothing under `test/`, `docs/testing-and-ci.md`, `package.json` or `e2e-smoke.js` has changed)

**Constraints from the parent (all pieces):** nothing new at the repo root. `signal-guard.js` and `protected-paths.js` stay untouched. Each piece is its own PR, with its own run of `npm test`, plus `test:system` / `test:mutation` where the piece touches them. Out of scope, for the parent's close-out to list (not file): a scheduled/CI heavy-tier run (LIN-3160), pinned Harbour per dispatcher commit, splitting `run-mutations.js`, a test-infra module map, `e2e-smoke.js` joining the tier, the shared source sandbox.

comments.body: Observation from LIN-4220's review (PR https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/318, merged as 52d2c3d): `npm run test:mutation` on the PR head failed once in two runs, before any mutant ran. The baseline failed on `test/system/wake-invariants.test.js` with ECONNREFUSED on its fixed port **4141**. The second run passed (67/67 killed), and main passed too. PR #318 touches no ports and no wake suite, so this is the fixed-port class this ticket owns. Please include `wake-invariants.test.js` / port 4141 in the fixed-port census and the OS-assigned-port conversion.

**Beat 1/4 — grounding and failing witnesses (branch `feat/lin-4222-one-owner-ports`, off `main` @ `90bbf82`)**

Staleness: `git log` since the ticket's creation shows LIN-4220 (`52d2c3d`), LIN-4223 (`54febbf`) and LIN-4221 (`90bbf82`) all touched `test/system/harness` and `test/system` after the grounding commit `502901c`. LIN-4221 is on `main`: `exit-codes.js`, `preflight.js` (with the `ports` need, inert with no fixed ports) and the `COULDNT_RUN` runner path are present. `harbour.js` now has `childEnv('descendant')` and `stop-group` (detached, group stop). `waitForServer` is still at `harbour.js:37-49`, and `startHarbour({ port = 4123 })` is still there. `test/system/harness/ports.js` does not exist yet.

**Literal-port inventory (`test/system/*.test.js`, census rule (c) matches 31 sites in 26 files):**
- `systemSuite(..., { port: N })`, 24 files: abort-attribution 4145, close-on-done 4142, credential-rearm 4146, dead-session-reaping 4144, fast-fail-watchdog 4150, follow-up-resume-race 4151, follow-up-resume 4147, halt-mechanism 4152, happy-path 4124, harbour-halt 4161, launch-failure 4143, launch-pacing 4148, lifecycle 4129, local-halt 4162, misbehaviour 4126, observation-feed 4125, pending-child-relay 4163, properties 4130 (also `timeout: 180000`), reaper-failsafe 4131, run-once 4127, wake-invariants 4141, plus `run-smoke` 4149 (an object option, not `systemSuite`).
- Module-level `const PORT`, 3 files: boot 4123, tap1-openrouter 4128, auto-pause 4163 (the restart case: it passes the port back in, so it becomes `harbour.port`).
- `harbour-stop.test.js`: six `startHarbour({ port })` sites, 4391-4396 (two inside template-string child scripts).
- Harness defaults to delete: `harbour.js:90` (`port = 4123`), `harness/run.js:25` (`port = 4149`). Doc-comment examples: `harness/suite.js:5`, `test/system/README.md:57`.
- Outside the census scope (unit-tier, `test/*.test.js`): `preflight-wiring.test.js` (`startHarbour({ port: 4998 })` in a child script) and `mutation-runner.test.js` (`port: Number(process.env.FIXTURE_PORT)`). Both pass an explicit port, which the restart path keeps.
- `wake-invariants.test.js` on 4141 is a plain `systemSuite` with no fixed-port dependency. No code outside the tests uses 4141. It converts with no registry entry.

**Failing witnesses (committed, red on purpose):**
- `test/system/harbour-ports.test.js`: (b) allocator not used, `0 !== 1`. (c) a port held by another server resolves as ready, so the assertion `must not boot as ready` fails. (c) with the first port held, the retry never fires, `0 !== 2`. Characterisation (restart on the same port keeps its address and data) passes.
- `test/ports-registry.test.js`: fails with `Cannot find module './system/harness/ports'` (the module is beat 3's to create).
- `test/child-env-census.test.js`, new rule (c) block: the real-tree check fails with the 31-site list. The seeded-shape checks pass.

Drift from the ticket: there is no EADDRINUSE retry in `harbour.js` today. The only EADDRINUSE behaviour is the false ready, so there is no retry to characterise. Beat 3 adds the retry.

**Beat 2/4 committed on `feat/lin-4222-one-owner-ports` as `ed28697` (not pushed, no PR).**

- `test/system/harness/ports.js` (new): `allocatePort()` (bind 0, read, release), an empty frozen `FIXED_PORTS` registry, and `registryProblems()` (needs an integer port and a reason).
- `harbour.js`: no default port. Without one, it allocates per attempt (injectable). Readiness = the child's own startup line `Harbour running at http://localhost:<port>` + an HTTP answer + still alive after it. A child exit ends the wait at once. EADDRINUSE is retried on a fresh port, up to 3 attempts. A failed attempt stops its group.
- `run.js`: the 4149 default is removed.
- Fake Harbour servers in the tests now print the same startup line (scaffolding only, no assertions changed).

Green: harbour-ports (4/4), ports-registry (7/7), harbour-stop + harness-reap + stop-group + boot against real Harbour (24/24), and the unit tests touching the harness. The only red is census rule (c) real-tree, as planned until beat 3.

**Beat 3/4 committed on `feat/lin-4222-one-owner-ports` as `5781fdc` (not pushed, no PR).**

- Every `test/system/*.test.js` now runs on an OS-assigned port. 31 literal sites in 26 files are gone. `systemSuite` refuses a `port` option. The restart in `auto-pause` passes back `harbour.port`, which is the pass-back the restart case needs.
- `wake-invariants` (4141) is converted, not registered: nothing outside the test depends on 4141. `FIXED_PORTS` stays empty.
- Census rule (c): the real-tree check passes now. The seeded-shape checks still fail on a literal port.
- `npm test`: 4189 pass, 0 fail.
- `npm run test:system`, run twice concurrently: 142 pass, 2 fail, identical both times.

**Pre-existing, not from this change.** The two failing tests are "a completed standalone run appears as a terminal session in the Sessions view" (observation-feed) and "generating a run summary drives Harbour's real OpenRouter client to the fake" (tap1). They fail the same way on `main` (`90bbf82`), on the beat-2 commit, and when run alone. Harbour's session materialization does not produce the terminal session and loopId these tests wait for, on LinearViewer `main` at `eb44eff9`. This needs a Harbour-side owner. The ticket's "full `test:system` green" acceptance is blocked on it.

**Summary: PR is open for review. Not merged; Done not set (review and close-out follow).**

PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/320 (base `main` @ `90bbf82`, head `feat/lin-4222-one-owner-ports` @ `5781fdc604982ef5a9cc9489b0bf841723345c58`)

Commits (in order): `2d0d10e` (beat 1, failing witnesses), `ed28697` (beat 2, harness: `ports.js` registry + allocator, OS-assigned port, readiness owned by the child, bounded EADDRINUSE retry), `5781fdc` (beat 3, all `test/system` literal ports converted, census rule (c) lands).

**CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`, job `unit tests`, runs `npm ci` + `npm test` on ubuntu/Node 22):** SUCCESS on head `5781fdc`. Run: https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/actions/runs/41844668355 (job 126624946259). Totals: 4180 tests, 4173 pass, 7 skipped (darwin-only suites), 0 fail.

**Witnesses confirmed in that CI log (names):**
- harbour ports: "(b) with no port given, the harness allocates one and the child serves on that same port"; "(c) a port held by another server is not reported ready: the boot fails with the child's own EADDRINUSE"; "(c) when the first port is held, the boot retries on a fresh one, and never reports the other server as Harbour"; "characterisation: a restart that passes the port back in keeps its address and its data"
- ports registry: "starts empty: no system test file is granted a fixed port by default"; "an entry without a recorded reason is reported"; "an entry with a blank reason is reported"
- census rule (c): "the real test/system/*.test.js files have no literal port"; "flags each literal-port shape on a seeded line"

**Local:** `npm test` 4189 pass / 0 fail on macOS (5 skipped). `npm run test:system` (concurrent), run twice: 142 pass, 2 fail, identical both times.

**Mutation checks** (each broken, the named test went red, then restored): accept any HTTP answer as ready; drop the retry; restore a fixed default port; non-empty registry; reason check removed; a literal port in `boot.test.js`.

**Pre-existing `test:system` failures, not from this change:** "a completed standalone run appears as a terminal session in the Sessions view" (observation-feed) and "generating a run summary drives Harbour's real OpenRouter client to the fake (not the mock)" (tap1). Both fail identically on `main` @ `90bbf82` with the same pinned LinearViewer checkout (`eb44eff9`), on the beat-2 commit, and when run alone. CI does not run `test:system` (only `npm test`), so these are not in CI.

**Wake-invariants (4141):** converted, not registered. `FIXED_PORTS` is empty.

## Review — LIN-4222

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/320 at head `5781fdc604982ef5a9cc9489b0bf841723345c58` (base `main` @ `90bbf82`). LinearViewer checkout is at `eb44eff9`.

CI: green. `unit tests` on `5781fdc` passed (run 41844668355). CI runs only `npm test`. I re-ran `test:system` myself on head and on main; results are below.

### Scope vs plan
The changed files match the plan: `ports.js` is new, `harbour.js`, `suite.js` and `run.js` lost their port defaults, all 26 `test/system/*.test.js` files are converted, and census rule (c) is added. `signal-guard.js` and `protected-paths.js` are not touched. `wake-invariants` (4141) was converted, not added to the registry. `FIXED_PORTS` is empty and frozen. `auto-pause` restarts on `harbour.port`. Readiness now needs three things: Harbour's own listen line (confirmed at `LinearViewer/server.js:4574`), an HTTP answer, and the child still alive. When the child exits, the wait ends at once. A boot that fails with EADDRINUSE is retried up to 3 times on a new port. Each failed attempt stops its own process group, so the LIN-4223 group-stop is still in place.

**Regression check:** `git log` on `harbour.js`, `suite.js`, `run.js` and `auto-pause.test.js` shows nothing reverted. The LIN-4223 group-stop and forget-record fix (`54febbf`) is kept in `bootOnce`. LIN-4221 preflight still runs before every boot.

**One or a class?** Searching the repo for literal ports turned up two sites outside `test/system`, both in the unit tier:
- `test/preflight-wiring.test.js:79,104` uses 4998. It never binds, because Harbour is missing there on purpose.
- `test/mutation-runner.test.js:238` passes in an allocated `FIXTURE_PORT`.

Neither is a defect. `config.js` and `feedback.js` use `localhost:3000`, which is a product default, a different class. Apart from those, the change is complete for its class.

### Findings
1. **The evidence in the implementation summary is wrong, though the claim behind it holds.** The summary says the `harbour ports` witnesses (b) and (c) and the restart characterisation appear in the CI log. They cannot: `test/system/harbour-ports.test.js` is in the system tier, and CI's `npm test` only globs `test/*.test.js`. The CI log (32k lines) holds only `census rule (c)`, `fixed-port registry` and `preflight: ports…`. I ran the witnesses myself, as recorded below. Close-out has nothing to fix here; this is a note on the evidence only.
2. **Mutation checks I ran.** Each mutation was reverted afterwards.
   - Readiness accepts any HTTP answer (listen-line gate replaced by `true`): both (c) tests go red.
   - Retry dropped (`if (!boot.bindLost) break;` → `break;`): the retry test goes red.
   - Allocation replaced by a fixed default (`fixedPort ?? 4123`): (b) and the retry test go red.
   - A literal `startHarbour({ port: 4123 })` put back into `boot.test.js`: census rule (c) goes red, 1 failure.

   All four load-bearing witnesses catch what they claim to.
3. **Minor: `systemSuite` refusing a `port` option has no witness.** Grep finds no test that asserts the `takes no port` TypeError. Close-out fix: add one `it` to `test/ports-registry.test.js` that asserts `assert.throws(() => require('./system/harness/suite').systemSuite('x', { port: 1 }, () => {}), /takes no port/)`. The function throws before it calls `describe`, so no Harbour boots.

### Substitute for the system tier (I re-ran it myself; CI does not run it)
- `npm test` on head: 4194 tests, 4189 pass, 0 fail, 5 skipped (macOS).
- `npm run test:system` on head: 144 tests, 142 pass, 2 fail.
- `npm run test:system` on main `90bbf82` (worktree, same LinearViewer checkout): 140 tests, 138 pass, 2 fail.
- The failing test names are **identical** on both branches:
  - "a completed standalone run appears as a terminal session in the Sessions view" (observation-feed)
  - "generating a run summary drives Harbour's real OpenRouter client to the fake (not the mock)" (tap1)
- Head runs 4 more tests than main; they are the new `harbour-ports` witnesses, and all pass.
- `pending-child-relay` and `LIN-2995 S6 auto-pause` both pass in the same concurrent run. They shared 4163 before this change, so that witness is met. `wake invariants` passes too.
- What this run cannot prove: it is one macOS host with no separate clean environment. It does not cover commits after `5781fdc`. Two runs cannot tell a flake from a fix.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (rule: readiness belongs to the Harbour you started; restart keeps its port). The four `harbour-ports.test.js` witnesses and the shared-port pair (`pending-child-relay` + `auto-pause`) are not in CI. **Discharged at `5781fdc`** by my local `test:system` run and the mutation checks above. If the head moves, close-out re-runs `node --require ./test/isolate-run.js --test test/system/harbour-ports.test.js` before merge. The right result is 4/4 pass.
- **Inside** (the piece touches the mutation tier, and the ticket requires `test:mutation` where a piece touches it). Neither the implementer nor I ran `npm run test:mutation` on head. Its baseline is where the `wake-invariants` ECONNREFUSED on 4141 showed up. **Before merge:** close-out runs `npm run test:mutation` once on the merge head. The right result is a clean baseline, with no ECONNREFUSED or EADDRINUSE in any `test/system` file, and the killed count matches main's (67/67 on LIN-4220's run).
- **Inside** (acceptance: "preflight's `ports` need applies only to registry files"). `FIXED_PORTS` is not wired to `preflight({ fixedPorts })`. `systemSuite` refuses a port, so a future registry file would have no path to its fixed port or to the ports check. With an empty registry nothing changes in behaviour: preflight skips the ports need when `fixedPorts` is empty, and `test/preflight.test.js:68` checks exactly that. **Settle by an explicit drop, with the reason recorded:** wiring a path that no file uses would be speculative. The first registry entry must add that wiring, together with the reason the entry needs. Close-out records the drop on LIN-4219.
- **Outside** (a different problem: Harbour-side session materialization and the Tap 1 summary path). The testing strategy says "the full `npm run test:system` run is green". It is not green, because of the two failures above. They are identical on main, so this change did not cause them. **Follow-up:** close-out files a LinearViewer/Harbour ticket for the two failures, after checking one does not already exist, and records that "full test:system green" is met except for these two pre-existing failures. LIN-4224's scripted baseline should list them as known-red until that ticket closes.
- **Inside** (the reason for this ticket: fixed-port flakes in the heavy tier). Removing the port-clash flake (4141 ECONNREFUSED, the shared 4163) can only show up over repeated runs. **Monitor:** LIN-4224's `npm run test:baseline` and every `test:mutation` baseline. A port flake fails loudly there as `Harbour exited before it became ready … EADDRINUSE` after 3 attempts, or as ECONNREFUSED in a system file. **Rollback:** revert the merge commit of PR #320. It is test-only, so the revert is clean.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. The work matches the approved plan and the acceptance, the witnesses are real, and the test:system failures are the same as on main. Before merge, close-out runs `test:mutation` on the merge head, adds the missing `systemSuite` port-refusal witness (finding 3), records the registry-to-preflight drop on LIN-4219, and files the Harbour-side follow-up for the two pre-existing failures.

## Close-out — LIN-4222

**Merged:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/320, squash-merged as `3330526` onto `main`, pinned with `--match-head-commit 04f4b80`. Test-only change, nothing deploys, so there is no post-deploy step.

**Review verdict:** Approve, conditional on the ledger. Settled below.

**Changes I made after approval**
- `04f4b80` — adds the witness that `systemSuite` refuses a `port` option (`test/ports-registry.test.js`, answers review finding 3). I checked it goes red with the refusal removed and green with it in place.
- No other code changes. No stale citations or comments needed fixing.

**CI on the exact head `04f4b80`:** `unit tests` SUCCESS (run 41846222746). Local `npm test`: 4195 tests, 4190 pass, 0 fail, 5 skipped. CI runs only `npm test`.

**Ledger**
- *Inside, `harbour-ports` witnesses and the shared-4163 pair:* I re-ran `node --require ./test/isolate-run.js --test test/system/harbour-ports.test.js` on the new head: 4/4 pass. The shared-4163 pair and the mutation checks were discharged by review at `5781fdc`; the head moved only by the one test file.
- *Inside, `test:mutation` on the merge head:* ran `npm run test:mutation` on `04f4b80`: 67/67 killed, a clean baseline, zero ECONNREFUSED/EADDRINUSE in the log.
- *Inside, registry-to-preflight wiring:* dropped with the reason recorded on LIN-4219 (no file uses a fixed port; the first registry entry must add the wiring with its reason).
- *Outside, `test:system` not green:* two failures, identical on `main`. Both already have tickets, so I filed none: observation-feed → LIN-4187, tap1 → LIN-4188. Both are linked as `related` and commented. "Full test:system green" is met except for these two.
- *Inside, port-flake monitor/rollback:* the monitor named by review is LIN-4224's `npm run test:baseline` and every `test:mutation` baseline; a port flake fails there as `Harbour exited before it became ready … EADDRINUSE` after 3 attempts, or as ECONNREFUSED in a system file. Rollback named by review: revert merge commit `3330526` (test-only, clean). I posted a note on LIN-4224 so its baseline lists the two known-red tests.

**What this does not prove:** no repeated-run evidence yet that the port flake is gone; one macOS host, no separate clean environment. That is why the named monitor above exists.

**Housekeeping:** description archived (snapshot confirmed) and the approved-plan slice pruned to a stub; problem statement, testing strategy and acceptance kept. LIN-4219 has the close-out note. No unresolved rulings.

**Autopilot (stepper) run summary — LIN-4222**

Outcome: PR https://github.com/JKershaw/simple-dispatcher/pull/320 squash-merged as `3330526`, LIN-4222 Done. CI `unit tests` green on the merged head `04f4b80` (run 41846222746) and on `main` @ `3330526` post-merge.

Beats (one warm session, ROOT b42e4018): 1/4 ground + failing witnesses (`2d0d10e`) · 2/4 harness: `ports.js` empty registry, OS-assigned port, child-owned readiness, bounded EADDRINUSE retry (`ed28697`) · 3/4 all 31 literal-port sites in 26 `test/system` files converted, `wake-invariants` converted (registry stays empty), census rule (c) (`5781fdc`) · 4/4 mutation proof, PR, CI.
Then: independent `review` (Approve, conditional) → `close-out` (added the `systemSuite` port-refusal witness `04f4b80`, `test:mutation` 67/67, merged, Done).

Verified by me on GitHub/Linear (not on worker say-so): PR MERGED; all 35 changed files under `test/`; CI success on the exact head and on the merge commit.

What holds: no default ports remain; fixed-port registry is empty; readiness belongs to the started child.

What's left / not proven: CI runs only `npm test`, so the system tier has no CI signal. `npm run test:system` is 142 pass / 2 fail locally, and the same two tests fail on `main` (observation-feed standalone-run terminal session, tap1 OpenRouter fake), tracked as LIN-4187 and LIN-4188. So the ticket's "full system suite green" is not literally met, for reasons independent of this change. That is a call for the human: accept as is, or hold LIN-4222's acceptance until those two are fixed. Port-flake absence needs repeated runs (LIN-4224 baseline).
